finding.root_cause: The centre-scale WarpRectilinear fit fixes kr0 at 1.0. In a fixed-size output this maps the corrected corners to approximately 92.1 percent of the source radius, so the loss is geometric correction magnification rather than a TIFF crop.
finding.unsafe_candidate_rejected: Scaling a radial warp until the output corner reaches the source corner samples beyond the source rectangle at the top and bottom edge centres.
finding.accepted_policy: Uniformly scale all RGB plane polynomials by the exact largest common factor whose complete rectangular boundary remains in-bounds. This preserves relative lateral-CA geometry and keeps the radial derivative positive.

claim_boundary: The accepted policy maximizes an in-bounds centred radial correction for the fixed 4:3 RAW lattice. It cannot retain every uncorrected corner while also removing barrel distortion; complete uncorrected framing remains available by disabling distortion correction. Phocus visual confirmation is still required before release sealing.
